label: release-0.3.16
scope: Assets/_Project serialized media; enabled-scene + Resources GUID reachability; known catalog/audio roles. Runtime dynamic strings and visual appearance still require Unity QA.

ui_icons.limitation: Standalone file existence does not prove ExpeditionArt runtime resolver loads it; confirm resolver/Unity QA.

notes.detail: Null rewardKeySprite/Blueprint/Tesseract scene fields cannot load img/ resources in a Player via the editor-only AssetDatabase helper; bind existing icons in scene or use runtime Resources.
Four dedicated shared difficulty frames are assigned by the completed media importer. Per-monster overrides may remain null because the shared catalog supplies them.
Current sound design contains event SFX; no background music or continuous mine/forge ambience system was found in project scripts. These are additional production work, not broken clips.

The travelling mine lift has visual animation but no dedicated mechanical playback/clip in the current Expedition presenter or audio bank. Preserve the existing selected-audio scope unless adding new sound design is requested.
Heroes/monsters use static illustrations with UI movement and effects. Dedicated idle/attack/hurt/death frame sets are absent; no missing rig/clip is inferred from that design.

Skin unlocks and selection now persist in protected server storage and the paired avatar is derived from the skin. Remote friends/leaderboard/battle opponent views still need a public profile integration to fetch other players' cosmetic IDs.
Null Image sprites for fills, lines, transparent hit targets, locks, borders, particles and empty equipment slots are intentional; do not count them as media gaps.

DuelMatch3Manager editor auto-assignment still mentions petarda/cross/square/shield/fury.png names absent from img/butt_spells, but shipped scene has all five real ability sprite refs; this is stale tooling, not missing shipped artwork.

MineScene slot sprite fields originally pointed to repair.png/arena.png. GetEquipmentSlotSprite has no callers in current source; these dormant old fields do not represent visible missing sprites. The real Hero slot ghosts use Expedition UI icons.
